summary_en: HANWA will acquire up to 3.5 million shares (1.8% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of 5.0 billion yen through open market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between November 9, 2026 and May 31, 2027 to enhance shareholder returns and capital efficiency.
title_en: Notice of Determination of Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
HANWA Co., Ltd. announced on November 6, 2026 that its Board of Directors resolved to acquire treasury stock based on Article 156 of the Companies Act, as applied by Article 165(3). The company will purchase up to 3.5 million shares, representing 1.82% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock as of September 30, 2026), for a maximum aggregate consideration of 5.0 billion yen.

The acquisition will be conducted through open market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between November 9, 2026 and May 31, 2027. As of September 30, 2026, the company held 19,866,741 treasury shares against 191,796,459 outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock). The company cited two objectives for this buyback program: returning value to shareholders and improving capital efficiency.
